extracted.name: Garlicky Green Beans with Shallot
extracted.description: This recipe seasons green beans with shallot and garlic and then adds Parmesan cheese for a great side dish suitable for Thanksgiving dinner.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Melt butter with olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook shallot and garlic in the hot butter mixture, stirring frequently, until soft and slightly browned, 5 to 10 minutes.
Stir green beans with shallot mixture; season with salt and pepper. Cook and stir green beans until tender, about 12 minutes.
Remove skillet from heat and sprinkle Parmesan cheese over the green beans.
